summary: Thomson Reuters filed a Form 6-K on May 1, 2026, announcing final terms of a return-of-capital and share consolidation. The company will distribute US$1.435518 per common share (aggregate ~US$605M) and consolidate shares at a 1:0.984560 reverse stock split, effective May 4, 2026. Shareholders could opt out of the cash distribution, receiving instead a proportionate equity interest increase via the consolidation. Computershare acts as depositary. The $605M return-of-capital is a special dividend-like payout, funded from surplus cash, reducing equity base without altering business structure. Watch how post-consolidation liquidity and tax treatment affect shareholder value; risk-arb is minimal given the fixed cash component and proportional split.
